mapper.select: SELECT id, vessel_id, period_year, period_month, crew_name, crew_role, incident_type, incident_date, diagnosis, evacuation_required, return_to_duty_date, excel_upload_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM tb_sea_crew_incident WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT sc.id, sc.vessel_id, v.name AS vessel_name, sc.period_year, sc.period_month, sc.crew_name, sc.crew_role, sc.incident_type, sc.incident_date, sc.diagnosis, sc.evacuation_required, sc.return_to_duty_date, sc.excel_upload_id, sc.created_at FROM tb_sea_crew_incident sc LEFT JOIN tb_vessel v ON v.id = sc.vessel_id
ORDER BY sc.incident_date DESC, sc.created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_sea_crew_incident ( vessel_id, period_year, period_month, crew_name, crew_role, incident_type, incident_date, diagnosis, evacuation_required, return_to_duty_date, excel_upload_id, created_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{vesselId}, #{periodYear}, #{periodMonth}, #{crewName}, #{crewRole}, #{incidentType}, #{incidentDate}, #{diagnosis}, #{evacuationRequired}0, #{returnToDutyDate}, #{excelUploadId}, SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 )

INSERT INTO tb_sea_crew_incident ( vessel_id, period_year, period_month, crew_name, crew_role, incident_type, incident_date, diagnosis, evacuation_required, return_to_duty_date, excel_upload_id, created_at, deleted ) VALUES
( #{it.vesselId}, #{it.periodYear}, #{it.periodMonth}, #{it.crewName}, #{it.crewRole}, #{it.incidentType}, #{it.incidentDate}, #{it.diagnosis}, #{it.evacuationRequired}0, #{it.returnToDutyDate}, #{it.excelUploadId}, SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sea_crew_incident SET deleted = 1, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
